evals.name: measure-before-optimize
evals.prompt: A JSON serialization path is suspected to be slow. How should you profile and benchmark it before making changes?
evals.expected_output: Writing a Benchmark function with b.ReportAllocs() and running go test -benchmem -cpuprofile.
assertions: Creates table benchmark with b.ResetTimer() and b.ReportAllocs().
Captures baseline CPU/memory profile with pprof.
Compares optimization diff using benchstat before committing changes.

evals.name: reduce-heap-allocations
evals.prompt: Optimize a high-throughput network packet parser that allocates 100,000 byte slices per second.
evals.expected_output: Memory optimization using sync.Pool for buffer reuse and pre-allocated slices.
assertions: Uses sync.Pool to reuse byte buffer structs across requests.
Resets buffer state before returning to pool.
Reduces heap allocations measured by -benchmem to zero or near-zero.

evals.name: buffered-batch-io
evals.prompt: A logging service writes log lines to disk one-by-one, causing high disk I/O wait. Optimize it.
evals.expected_output: Implementation of buffered I/O with bufio.Writer and periodic flush.
assertions: Wraps raw file writer with bufio.NewWriterSize.
Batches write operations to minimize syscall overhead.
Flushes buffer on timer or shutdown to prevent data loss.
